annotation.title_clean: The Africa Declaration on Artificial Intelligence / La Déclaration Africaine sur l'Intelligence Artificielle
annotation.title_en: The Africa Declaration on Artificial Intelligence
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Smart Africa; African Union; African ministers and representatives (Kigali)
annotation.venue: Global AI Summit on Africa, Kigali (C4IR Rwanda)
annotation.summary_en: Bilingual (English/French) declaration signed in Kigali on 4 April 2025 by African states, the African Union and Smart Africa. It sets principles and commitments on AI talent, open data, sovereign compute, market and a $60 billion Africa AI Fund. It has no robotics or embodied-AI content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Guiding principles: sovereignty, inclusivity, harm prevention, privacy, transparency, dignity and sustainability
Create an African AI Scientific Panel and continent-wide AI education and literacy programmes
Frameworks for open datasets and models, and robust data governance aligned with the AU Data Policy Framework
Deploy sovereign distributed compute and regional HPC data centres
Establish a $60 billion Africa AI Fund, an Africa-first procurement approach and AI regulatory sandboxes
